privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how Smart Job Portal collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
privacy.ctaDescription: Our privacy team is here to help. Contact us for any data-related inquiries.

collection.heading: Information We Collect
collection.intro: We collect information you provide directly when you create an account, upload your CV, apply for jobs, or contact us. This includes:
items: Name, email address, and contact information
Professional experience, education, and skills
CV/resume documents you upload
Job applications and saved job preferences
Account settings and communication preferences
Usage data such as pages visited and features used

usage.heading: How We Use Your Information
usage.intro: We use your information to provide and improve our services, including:
items: Matching you with relevant job opportunities using our AI technology
Facilitating job applications between job seekers and companies
Personalizing your job search and recommendation experience
Analyzing your CV/resume to extract and structure professional data
Sending notifications about application status updates
Improving our platform and developing new features

sharing.heading: Data Sharing
sharing.intro: We share your information only in the following circumstances:
items: With employers: When you apply for a job, the hiring company receives your application and profile data.
Service providers: We may share data with trusted third-party services that help us operate our platform.
Legal requirements: We may disclose information if required by law or to protect our rights.
sharing.note: We never sell your personal data to third parties for advertising or marketing purposes.

security.heading: Data Security
security.paragraph: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including encryption in transit and at rest, secure authentication, and regular security audits. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.intro: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
items: Access: Request a copy of your personal data.
Correction: Update or correct inaccurate information.
Deletion: Request deletion of your account and data.
Export: Download your data in a portable format.
Opt-out: Unsubscribe from marketing communications at any time.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.paragraph: We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain your session, remember your preferences, and improve your experience. Essential cookies are required for the platform to function. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

account.title: 1. Account Usage
account.p1: By accessing or using Smart Job Portal, you agree to be bound by these Terms. You are responsible for safeguarding the password that you use to access the Service and for any activities or actions under your password, whether your password is with our Service or a third-party service.
account.p2: You agree not to disclose your password to any third party. You must notify us immediately upon becoming aware of any breach of security or unauthorized use of your account.

seeker.title: 2. Job Seeker Responsibilities
seeker.p1: As a job seeker, you agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during the registration process and to update such information to keep it accurate, current, and complete.
seeker.bullet1: You will not misrepresent your identity or qualifications.
seeker.bullet2: You will use the AI Matching features responsibly and not attempt to manipulate the scoring algorithms.
seeker.bullet3: You acknowledge that Smart Job Portal does not guarantee job placement.

company.title: 3. Company Responsibilities
company.p1: Employers and recruiters using the platform must ensure that all job postings comply with applicable local, state, national, and international laws, including labor and employment laws regarding non-discrimination.
company.p2: Companies are solely responsible for their postings on the platform and any consequences that arise from them. The platform reserves the right to remove any posting that violates these terms without prior notice.

postings.title: 4. Job Posting Rules
postings.p1: To maintain the quality of our data-driven matching ecosystem, all job postings must:
postings.bullet1: Clearly describe the role, responsibilities, and required skills.
postings.bullet2: Not contain hidden fees, pyramid schemes, or inappropriate content.
postings.bullet3: Accurately reflect the compensation if provided.

limitations.title: 5. Platform Limitations
limitations.p1: Smart Job Portal utilizes advanced machine learning algorithms to facilitate talent matching. However, we do not warrant that the Service will function uninterrupted, secure, or available at any particular time or location.
limitations.p2: We are not responsible for the actions, content, information, or data of third parties, and you release us, our directors, officers, employees, and agents from any claims and damages, known and unknown, arising out of or in any way connected with any claim you have against any such third parties.

termination.title: 6. Termination Policy
termination.p1: We may terminate or suspend your account immediately, without prior notice or liability, for any reason whatsoever, including without limitation if you breach the Terms.
termination.p2: Upon termination, your right to use the Service will immediately cease. If you wish to terminate your account, you may simply discontinue using the Service.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about setting up your profile, applying for jobs, and understanding our AI matching technology.
faq.noResultsHelp: Try different keywords or browse categories.
faq.ctaTitle: Still can't find what you're looking for?
faq.ctaDescription: Our support team is available 24/7 to help you with any specific issues.

verifyEmail.q: How do I verify my professional email?
verifyEmail.a: To verify your email, navigate to Settings > Account > Email Preferences. Click the "Send Verification Link" button next to your primary email address. You will receive an email from Smart Job Portal within 5 minutes containing a secure, time-sensitive link.
verifyEmail.tip: If you don't see the email, please check your spam folder or ensure your company's firewall allows emails from no-reply@smartjobportal.com.

hideProfile.q: Can I hide my profile from my current employer?
hideProfile.a: Yes! Go to Settings > Privacy and enable "Stealth Mode." This will hide your profile from specific companies you list. Your profile will still be visible to other employers and recruiters.

exportData.q: How do I export my profile data?
exportData.a: Navigate to Settings > Account > Data & Privacy. Click "Export My Data" to download a full copy of your profile, applications, and activity history in JSON or PDF format.

matchScore.q: How is the AI Matching Score calculated?
matchScore.a: Our AI analyzes over 50 factors including your skills, experience, education, location preferences, salary expectations, and career trajectory. It compares these against the job requirements using a proprietary weighted algorithm to generate a percentage match score.

about.heroTitle: Our Mission: Bridging the Talent Gap with Intelligence
about.heroDescription: We believe the future of work is built on human potential. By leveraging advanced AI, we remove bias and friction, creating a recruitment experience that is not only faster and more precise, but profoundly more human.
about.visionDescription: Smart Job Portal isn't just a job board; it's a talent intelligence platform. We envision a world where every individual is perfectly matched to a role where they can thrive, and every company builds teams that drive transformative innovation.
about.scienceSubtitle: Why we built an AI-first approach.

fairness.title: Radical Fairness
fairness.description: Our algorithms are trained to ignore demographic identifiers, focusing purely on skills, potential, and cultural alignment to eliminate unconscious bias.

precision.title: Surgical Precision
precision.description: By analyzing millions of successful career trajectories, our AI identifies subtle skill overlaps that traditional keyword matching misses entirely.

velocity.title: Accelerated Velocity
velocity.description: Reduce time-to-hire from weeks to days. Instant intelligent shortlisting means hiring managers spend time interviewing, not filtering resumes.

seekers.title: For Job Seekers: Find your potential.
seekers.description: Stop throwing resumes into the void. Smart Job Portal acts as your personal career agent, matching your unique skills to roles you didn't even know existed, with full transparency on salary and expectations.

companies.title: For Companies: Build your future team.
companies.description: Move beyond the spray-and-pray approach. Access a pre-vetted, highly targeted talent pool. Our AI understands your culture and tech stack, delivering candidates ready to make an impact on day one.
